(ii). Issue a writ of mandamus directing the respondent authorities to consider the creation of 4 additional posts of designated officers. "
Whether reporters of the local papers may be allowed to see the judgment?

Yes. 
2.

In response to the writ petition, the stand taken by the respondent-State reads as follows:-
"5.

In reply to this para, it is submitted that in pursuance to .
the Act, the State Govt. has promulgated the R&P Rules qua Designated Officer.
The process for filling up 5 posts of Designated Officer through direct recruitment has already been initiated.

So far filling up 5 posts through promotion is concerned, it is submitted that process for filling up 5 posts through promotion has been completed and Notification to this effect has been issued on 27.03.2015.
6.
That in reply to this para, it is submitted that the process for creation of more vacancies of designated officer has already been initiated.

However, it has been decided by the Govt. that the process for remaining 4 vacancies will be started once the process of filling up of 10 posts of designated officer in the department of health,
Safety and r regulation has completed."

3. Since, the respondent-State has already framed the R & P Rules and also initiated the process for filling up 10 posts of Designated Officers and has undertaken to initiate the process for filling up remaining 04 posts on the completion of the process, already initiated to fill up 10 posts, no order is required to be passed.
Therefore, the writ petition stand disposed of in view of the reply thereto filed by the respondent-State.
4. Pending application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of.
(Dharam Chand Chaudhary ) Judge (Tarlok Singh Chauhan) Judge th 13 May, 2015 (krn guleria) .
